issue.title: Support JS package initialization
issue.body:
There's a pretty good amount of desire to be able to write packages in JS in addition to CS, especially with the recentish addition of being able to leverage Babel. However the only way to generate a package currently is to generate it in CS. To facilitate JS package development, this PR adds templates for JS in addition to the existing CS templates.

I tried to keep the JS templates as close to the CS templates with minimal syntax changes, but obviously there's a lot of leeway there so let me know if there's anything you'd like to change.

Note that I branched off of #409 due to [this issue](https://github.com/atom/apm/issues/410), so once that PR is in I may need to clean this up a bit. And I'm having problems running the specs for the same reason, so I'm still looking into that but wanted to get this PR out there.

The next step after this would be to [allow JS package generation within the UI](https://github.com/atom/package-generator/issues/14).

issue.body:
This adds a schema for current-user to avoid data shape changing errors, as described in #3101  Also tidies up a test to use sinon rather than mockery.
## Testing Instructions
- Start Calypso with: 
  `ENABLE_FEATURES=persist-redux make run`
- In the console set localStorage.debug to `calypso:state`
- Refresh the page a few times and navigate to a few sections.
- The app behaves normally and loads the persisted state/current-user from IndexedDB storage

cc @rralian @aduth @artpi @mtias
